ERGO at a glance

The ERGO brand – our aspiration and our promise to our customers

We insure people and businesses. For us, a forward-looking approach and sustainability are a matter of course. Our focus is on our customers and their needs. It is important to them to be able to shape their world. We manage the risks. As an insurer, we do this as simply, quickly and conveniently as possible. The essence of our brand, ERGO – “Making insurance easier” – serves as a compass for our actions.

As an active companion at every stage of life. As a partner at eye level. As a positive initiator for the future. Simple because it matters.

Succeed - Women in Leadership

How women pursue successful careers at ERGO!

Women make a decisive contribution to the success of our company. That is why we are proud of our female managers. With the “Women in Leadership” initiative, we offer insights into the lives and development paths of women who can already look back on impressive careers today.

Sustainability at ERGO

We act responsibly, promote environmental and climate protection, create a good working environment and are socially committed.
Look forward with us and discover how ERGO embraces sustainability.

Hedging Risks

Responsible business practices

ERGO offers insurance solutions for new risks, relies on digital innovation and dialogue with customers, and integrates sustainable criteria into its investment policy.

An Investment in the future

Environmental and climate protection

ERGO invests in environmental and climate protection as an investment in the future. We specifically promote measures in our company and business to counteract the challenges of climate change.

  • How do small businesses stay optimistic amid economic uncertainty, rising risks and complex insurance decisions?💡

    ERGO NEXT Insurance’s new “Building Through Uncertainty” survey of 501 US entrepreneurs reveals:

    ✅ Entrepreneurs are more proactive in managing risk, despite inflation, cyber attacks, data breaches and broader economic concerns.
    ✅ Many small businesses buy insurance earlier, yet a large proportion remain underprotected, often due to perceived cost and complexity.
    ✅ AI is becoming a trusted first step for insurance questions, complementing agents and signalling a collaborative future for technology and human advice.
